title: Quotations on grain prices, the ever-normal granary, the salt and iron monopolies and the coinage of Qin, Han and Xin (Chapter 8)
source: 班固《汉书》（卷一上、六、八、九本纪；卷二十一上律历志，卷二十四上下食货志，卷二十八上下地理志，卷二十九沟洫志；卷六十九赵充国传，卷七十九冯奉世传，卷八十六王嘉传，卷九十九上中下王莽传）；司马迁《史记》（卷二十五律书，卷三十平准书，卷六十二管晏列传）；范晔《后汉书》（卷一上下光武帝纪）；《管子》（国蓄、山国轨、山至数、乘马数，四库全书提要与目录）；桓宽《盐铁论》（张之象注本：本议、力耕、错币、复古、水旱，四库全书提要）；all from the daizhigev20 corpus. 金谷治「『管子』輕重篇の成立」、『東洋史研究』43(1), 1984, pp. 142-164 (English summary)
series: one row per quoted fact: id, dynasty (or the text, for 管子), year (negative = BC; approximate where year_note says so), year_note, value (several values separated by ';', in the order of the quotation), unit, numeral (the classical numeral read by classical_numerals.py, compared with the value), file (a corpus key of verify_quotes.py, a corpus path, or a key of sources below), juan (卷 and chapter of the corpus, or 篇 for 管子 and 盐铁论; page for the article), quote (verbatim, including the corpus's annotations in 【】 and its private-use characters), note
license: Short quotations only, for comment and teaching. The classical texts are in the public domain; the digital text is the daizhigev20 corpus, whose repository states no licence. Kanaya (1984) is open access in the Kyoto University Research Information Repository (KURENAI), which states no licence for it; only seven short phrases of its English summary are quoted.
fetch: data/fetch/verify_quotes.py (rows with file hanshu, shiji, houhanshu); checks/check_ch08.py (rows with file 子藏/法家/管子.txt and 儒藏/语录/盐铁论.txt, see notes); data/fetch/verify_web_quotes.py (rows citing kanaya1984)
notes: Corpus: daizhigev20 at commit 4a6d6f2088825f132521d848c2ea86cf9c9a7620; tools/setup_env.sh adds 子藏/法家/管子.txt and 儒藏/语录/盐铁论.txt to the sparse checkout. verify_quotes.py checks only paths under 史藏/, so the 管子 and 盐铁论 rows are checked verbatim (whitespace ignored) by checks/check_ch08.py when the corpus is present ($CORPUS or ~/.cache/finance-study/daizhigev20). The 管子 and 盐铁论 of the corpus are the 四库全书 texts: unpunctuated, with annotations in 【】 (in 盐铁论 those of 张之象), and with variant forms (凖, 鐡, 嵗, 徃, 煑, 鼔, 乗, 夲 ...). The chapter prints them punctuated, in standard simplified forms and without the annotations; check_ch08.py checks that each printed quotation equals the corpus text after removing the annotations and mapping the variants (its table VARIANTS). Private-use characters: the corpus writes three characters with code points of the Unicode private use area, kept verbatim in the quote column: U+E511 for 榷 (酒榷, 榷酤; Wikisource's 盐铁论 卷一 and 提要 and the corpus's own 汉书食货志 have 榷), U+E3E7 for 弊 (钝弊; Wikisource's 盐铁论 卷六), U+EA5B for 傅 (傅子, in the 提要 of 管子; Wikisource). Second witness: Wikisource (zh.wikisource.org, traditional characters), raw wiki text retrieved 2026-10-14, compared after conversion to simplified characters (OpenCC t2s) with punctuation and annotations removed: 漢書/卷024 for every 食货志 row; 管子/第73篇國蓄, 第74篇山國軌, 第76篇山至數, 第69篇乘馬數 and the 管子 index page (its 提要); 鹽鐵論 (提要), 鹽鐵論/卷01 and 卷06; 史記/卷030 for the 平准书 row (sj_pz), 史記/卷025 for the 律书 row (wd_cheap), 史記/卷062 for the 管晏列传 row (sj_read); 漢書/卷006 for the 武帝纪 rows (wd_need, wd_wuzhu, wd_tang, wd_taishan), 卷099中 for the 王莽传中 rows (wmz_10, wmz_loan, wmz_penalty) and 卷099下 for the 王莽传下 rows (wmz_20, wmz_100k). Not compared: the rows from 高帝纪, 宣帝纪, 元帝纪, 律历志, 地理志, 沟洫志, 赵充国传, 冯奉世传, 王嘉传, 王莽传上 and 后汉书. The 管子 rows agree. Readings that differ: 凡宝货三物 (corpus) / 五物 (Wikisource): the chapter keeps both and notes that the text itself names five materials (金、银、龟、贝, and 铜 for 钱 and 布, row wm_metal); 啖食 (corpus, annotated 音谈) / 淡食 (Wikisource), the chapter keeps both; 唯直工大奸 / 唯真工大奸; 令吏坐市列物求利 / 坐市列贩物求利; 除其卖租铢之律 / 除其贩卖租铢之律; 不复告缗 / 不復告嬢 (Wikisource typo; not quoted); 如异时商贾所转者 (corpus) / 所轉貶者 (Wikisource 漢書/卷024; 貶 is taken as an error for 販, since the 史记 平准书 reads 各以其物贵时商贾所转贩者 in both the corpus and Wikisource 史記/卷030); 吾读管氏 / 吾读管子 (史记 管晏列传); 二曰以重养小 / 以重差小; 籴甚贵 / 籴其贵; 蓄积 / 畜积; 即准平 / 则准平; 或用轻钱 / 或用钱轻; 值 / 直; 淆 / 殽; 盐铁论: 専命水衡二官作吏近侵利 / 專命水衡三官作。吏匠侵利 (错币; not quoted, the chapter quotes only the following 或不中式故有薄厚轻重), 不知奸眞 / 不知奸貞 (not quoted), 取下 (Wikisource 鹽鐵論/卷07, retrieved 2026-10-14; the corpus heading is 盐铁取下第四十一): 猥以盐铁而为不便 / 猥以鹽、鐵為不便 (not quoted), 请且罢郡国榷酤 / 請且罷郡國榷沽 (酤 and 沽 both mean selling liquor; the chapter follows the corpus), 奏可 / 奏曰：「可。」 (not quoted), 开委府于京 / 委府于京师, 贵即卖 / 贵则卖, 非开利孔为民罪梯 / 非开利孔而为民罪梯, 吏容奸豪而富商 / 吏容奸豪吏富商, 煑盐 / 煮海为盐, 赋于民 / 赋与民, 桑宏羊 / 桑弘羊 (宏 for 弘 avoids the personal name of the Qianlong emperor). Readings of numbers: 亿 in the 汉书 is 万万 = 10^8: the 律历志 writes 见中日法 as 一亿三千四百八万二千二百九十七, a 亿 followed by tens of millions, and it is exactly three times 见月日法 四千四百六十九万四千九十九 (rows lv_zhongri, lv_yueri); 二百八十亿万 read literally would be 2.8 x 10^14 coins, about 4.7 million per person of 元始二年, so the chapter reads it as 280 亿 = 2.8 x 10^10 (亿万 is also used for 'countless', row gx_yiwan) and says that this is a reading; the 万万 numbers of 王嘉传 (treasuries under 元帝) are unambiguous. 余 after a number marks a lower bound; 数十万, 百余万 and 以十万数 are round numbers. Years: reign years are converted to the common era (汉元年 = 206 BC, 文帝元年 179 BC, 元狩元年 122 BC, 元鼎元年 116 BC, 元封元年 110 BC, 始元元年 86 BC, 元康元年 65 BC, 神爵元年 61 BC, 五凤元年 57 BC, 初元元年 48 BC, 永光元年 43 BC, 元始元年 AD 1, 居摄元年 AD 6, 始建国元年 AD 9, 天凤元年 AD 14, 地皇元年 AD 20, 建武元年 AD 25). Dated by the context of the corpus: 比年丰，谷石五钱 follows the death of 张安世 (元康四年) and precedes 神爵元年; the 宝货 follow 始建国二年 in 王莽传中; the 钟官 passage of 王莽传下 follows 地皇二年正月; the 五铢 restoration of 光武帝纪下 follows 建武十六年. Two records of one event differ in date: the abolition of the 常平仓 follows the famine of 初元二年 in 食货志上 but is dated 初元五年 in 元帝纪; the 货布 reform is dated 天凤元年 in 食货志下 and 地皇元年 in 王莽传下; the chapter gives both. 食货志下 calls the 宝货 二十八品 and 王莽传中 宝货五品. Kanaya (1984): the seven phrases are from the English summary on the last page of the PDF (PDF p. 24), found by verify_web_quotes.py in the -layout text layer.
